Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. "Lv.-" Digimon and Digimon cards without a level can't be targeted by effects that have levels in their conditions.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's effect to trash a Lv.- Digimon card in my hand, can I delete my opponent's Lv.- Digimon?

Effect: [Main] By trashing 1 Digimon card in your hand, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon whose level is less than or equal to the trashed card's level. When a card with [Myotismon] in its text is trashed by this effect, ＜Draw 2＞.
